STRICT RULE: Absolutely no music, only diegetic sounds; no one speaks.
Realism cinematic, real skin with pores and small marks, natural eyes, people and set lit only by this place's named sources: the low golden sun behind right, backlighting the maize leaves and rimming the hair, the spaces between the rows in soft shadow; warm natural colour with saturated, believable greens; dust drifting in the air.
Framed on the rule of thirds, with a light anamorphic lens character: softly oval out-of-focus highlights in the background, and a fine 35mm film grain.
Image reference 1 (location Crash site): the Crash site, its flattened maize, its neem trees and the towering craft 100% as in the reference.
Image reference 2 (character Devendra): Devendra, face, hair, body and clothes 100% as in the reference.
Image reference 3 (character Suman): Suman, face, hair, body and clothes 100% as in the reference.
Image reference 4 (character The boy): The boy, face, hair, body and clothes 100% as in the reference.
Continuity: Devendra is clean and unchanged from the reference, with no stain, mark or damage; Suman is clean and unchanged from the reference, with no stain, mark or damage; The boy is clean and unchanged from the reference, with no stain, mark or damage.
In frame only: Devendra, Suman and the boy. The edge of the maize field. Suman kneels at the field's edge, screen centre, near; the boy stands before her at arm's length with his back to the field, a broad swathe of flattened maize and torn red earth running from behind him into the field; Devendra stands a step behind Suman, screen left, near; the massive craft stands at the end of the swathe sixty steps in, far, towering over the neem trees beside it. Eyelines never at the camera.
Opening: Suman kneeling with the boy's hand in hers; the boy standing before her; Devendra standing a step behind her, his eyes on the boy.
Nobody speaks in this clip: Devendra, Suman and the boy never speak.
Devendra is out to understand where the child came from; once he sees the torn field he follows it with his eyes up the whole height of the craft, with resilience.
Suman is out to keep the child's hand in hers; once Devendra looks up she looks where he looks, with perseverance.
The boy is out to stay beside Suman; once she holds his hand he keeps it there, with persistence.
Pace: slow and hushed, one long tilt up the craft that takes its time; every shot opens in motion.
S1 0.0-1.8s · close, cut at the collarbones, three-quarter from the field side, slightly low, slow push-in · Devendra's eyes lift from the boy and travel past him and upward, his look going off right of the lens and up; Suman's plait and shoulder soft in the right foreground.
S2 1.8-3.4s · medium, from behind Devendra over his shoulder, slightly high, static · a broad swathe of flattened maize and torn red earth runs from the boy's back into the field; Suman kneeling and the boy standing near centre with their hands joined, Devendra's shoulder soft in the left foreground.
S3 3.4-9.4s · full, from behind the three at their eye level, one slow continuous tilt up · the three small in the lower third with their backs to the lens, Devendra standing, Suman kneeling, the boy beside her; the tilt climbs past the neem trees and on up the dark ribbed hull of the massive craft towering over them, its top edge entering frame at 8.0s; dust settling around its base, a low wind.
S4 9.4-11.0s · close, cut at the collarbones, from the front, low, handheld · Devendra's head tips back, his eyes climbing the hull off right of the lens and up, his hands open at his sides; only maize behind him.
S5 11.0-12.4s · insert, the foot of the craft from low in the flattened maize, static · settling dust rolls around heaped earth at the base of the hull; one small oval hatch stands open low to the ground, dark inside, just big enough for a small child; nobody in frame.
S6 12.4-14.0s · close, cut at the collarbones, three-quarter from Devendra's side, slightly high, slow push-in · Suman's eyes come up from the boy's hand in hers and climb the hull off right of the lens; the boy's shoulder soft in the right foreground.
All speech is in Hindi. Only the words inside double quotation marks are ever spoken aloud; every voice direction and every other word of this text stays silent.
No speech in S1, S2, S3, S4, S5, S6.
Restrictions:
- No music of any kind: no score, no soundtrack, no background music, no melody, no drone, no pad, no sting, no swell.
- No added sound effects: no whoosh, no boom, no impact hit, no riser.
- Only diegetic sound: the characters' voices and the natural sounds of this place.
- No words but the quoted lines, each only inside its own Audio window; outside them no one on screen speaks, whispers or mouths a word.
